Name: Bus Locations (Updated)
Author: Romz24
Description:
This is an updated version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2905]BusLocations[/url]﻿ mod, featuring bug fixes and improved compatibility with other mods.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]The bus can now be used during the Desert Festival
[*]The bus can now be used when Pam is visiting the doctor
[*]Fixed a bug where using a controller in the pause menu could trigger dialogue actions
[*]Added support for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21526]Button's Extra Books[/url] mod - the Bus Driving for Dummies book now functions correctly
[*]Added support for language files - the mod is now translatable into other languages
[/list]
[b]Special Thanks:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hootless[/b] - for creating the original mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2905]link[/url]﻿)
[*][b]comradesean[/b] - for implementing support for version 1.6 ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21264]link[/url]﻿)
[*][b]LyzzCL[/b] - for contributing ideas for some of the fixes ([url=https://github.com/LyzzCL/BusLocations/commit/d8b29d8d3f6b2d03c5b7e21677076c0e9d7d9497]link[/url]﻿)
[/list]
